title: Comb Occluder Sweep
name: comb_occluder_sweep
description: Three coloured blocks sit in a row on a table. A rigid comb frame hangs from sliding carriages on an overhead guide rail and moves horizontally in front of them; as it passes, each block is alternately hidden behind a bar and revealed in the gaps. After the supported comb slides fully past, all three blocks remain in place, unchanged in number and arrangement.
